# 325 Appraisal

> 325 Appraisal (www.325appraisal.com) is a California residential real estate appraisal service operated by Brian Ward, California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser (License AR036053), appraising since 2004 with more than 7,000 appraisals completed. It prepares non-lender appraisals — date-of-death and step-up in basis, estate and trust, divorce, bankruptcy, Proposition 19, property tax and gift tax, family transfers, insurance disputes, PMI removal, bail bonds, expert witness work and appraisal review. In-person appraisals throughout San Diego and Riverside Counties; desktop appraisals anywhere in California.

## Key facts
- Appraiser: Brian Ward, California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser, License AR036053
- Requests: online form at https://www.325appraisal.com/contact (written quotes by email, usually within one business day); email contact@325appraisal.com. No phone line is published; requests are handled in writing.
- In person: San Diego County and Riverside County. Desktop: statewide.
- Effective dates: current and retrospective (date of death, date of separation, petition date, lien date, date of loss).
- Payment: secure online invoice after the written quote is approved.
- Relationship: operated by Brian Ward; the main site for his business is Brian Ward Appraisal, https://www.brianward.com.

## Pricing (starting fees; final fee confirmed in writing)
- Basic Desktop Appraisal: $299 (Statewide) — A complete desktop analysis delivered in a concise report.
- Desktop Appraisal: $449 (Statewide) — Our most-ordered report: a full narrative desktop appraisal.
- Drive-By Appraisal: $649 (San Diego & Riverside Counties) — The desktop report plus an exterior visit to the property.
- Standard Appraisal: $699 (San Diego & Riverside Counties) — A full appraisal with an in-person interior and exterior inspection.
- Desktop Appraisal — 2 to 4 Units: $549 (Statewide) — Duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes valued from records, MLS data and supplied information.
- Standard Appraisal — 2 to 4 Units: $799 (San Diego & Riverside Counties) — A full appraisal of a 2–4 unit property with inspection of every unit.
- Add-ons: square-footage measurement $35 per 1,500 sq ft; rush delivery +30%; testimony and review quoted individually.

## Services
- [Date-of-Death Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/date-of-death-appraisals): Retrospective date-of-death appraisals for step-up in basis, estate tax returns, probate and trust administration anywhere in California (desktop) and in person in San Diego and Riverside Counties.
- [Estate & Trust Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/estate-trust-appraisals): Estate, probate and trust real estate appraisals for executors, trustees, attorneys and CPAs in California — inventories, trust funding and allocation, distributions and beneficiary buyouts, current or retrospective.
- [Divorce Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/divorce-appraisals): Neutral divorce and family-law home appraisals in California — current or date-of-separation values, shared by both spouses or retained by counsel, with expert testimony available.
- [Bankruptcy Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/bankruptcy-appraisals): Bankruptcy home appraisals for Chapter 7, 11 and 13 cases in California — petition-date or current values for schedules, trustee review, liquidation analysis and motions to value junior liens.
- [Proposition 19 Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/prop-19-appraisals): Proposition 19 appraisals for California parent-to-child and grandparent property transfers — fair market value at the date of transfer or death for reassessment and exclusion planning.
- [Property Tax & Gift Tax Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/tax-appraisals): Appraisals for California property tax appeals and Prop 8 decline-in-value reviews (January 1 lien date) and for IRS gift tax reporting of real estate transfers.
- [Pre-Purchase Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/pre-purchase-appraisals): Independent pre-purchase home appraisals in California for cash, off-market, family and unusual-property purchases — market value before the deposit is at risk.
- [Pre-Sale Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/pre-sale-appraisals): Pre-sale and pre-listing home appraisals in California for sellers, executors and trustees — an evidence-based asking price and a preview of the buyer's lender appraisal.
- [Family Transfer Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/family-transaction-appraisals): Appraisals for home sales, gifts and buyouts between family members in California — documented fair market value for IRS gift reporting and fairness among heirs.
- [Insurance Dispute Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/insurance-dispute-appraisals): Market-value appraisals for California insurance claim and coverage disputes — pre-loss and post-loss values and diminution in value, with litigation support available.
- [PMI Removal Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/pmi-removal-appraisals): PMI removal appraisals in San Diego and Riverside Counties — a current market value with interior inspection for loan servicers that accept borrower-ordered appraisals.
- [Bail Bond Appraisals](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/bail-bond-appraisals): Bail bond and property bond appraisals in California — supported market values documenting equity in pledged real estate, with rush delivery available.
- [Expert Witness & Litigation Support](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/expert-witness): Residential real estate appraisal expert witness services in California — litigation-grade reports, deposition, mediation, arbitration and trial testimony, and rebuttal review of opposing appraisals.
- [Appraisal Review & Second Opinions](https://www.325appraisal.com/services/appraisal-review): Formal USPAP appraisal reviews and second opinions in California — evaluation of another appraiser's data, comparables, adjustments and conclusions, with an optional independent value.
